chapterInfo.content:
32
Elihu asɛnka a ɛdi kan. Ɔkyerɛ deɛ enti a ɔkasa
1Ɛnna mmarima baasa yi gyaee Hiob bua, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ n’ani so teneneeni. 2#Gye 22.21; Hiob 9.20; 13.18; 19.6-7; 27.2, 6; 31.35 Na Busini Elihu a ɔyɛ Barakel ba a ɔfiri Ram abusua mu bo fui. Hiob na ne bo fuu no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔbu ne ho teneneeni sene Onyankopɔn. 3#Hiob 15.5; 18.21; 20.29; 22.5 Na ne bo fuu ne mfɛfoɔ baasa no nso, sɛ wɔnnya mmuaeɛ bi bio, nanso wɔbuu Hiob fɔ. 4Na Elihu twɛn maa Hiob kasae ansa, ɛfiri sɛ wɔsene no panin. 5Na Elihu hunuu sɛ mmuaeɛ biara nni mmarima baasa no anomu bio no, ne bo fui.
6Na Busini Elihu a ɔyɛ Barakel ba buaa sɛ:
Me deɛ, meyɛ abɔfra,
na mo deɛ moyɛ nkɔkoraa,
enti na metɔɔ me bo aseɛ,
na mesuroo sɛ mɛka deɛ menim makyerɛ mo.
7 # Hiob 12.12 Mekaa sɛ: Wɔmma onyinkyerɛ nkasa,
aane, na mfeɛ dodoɔ nkyerɛ nyansa.
8Ampa, honhom a ɛwɔ ɔdasani mu
ne Otumfoɔ ahome na ɛma no nhunumu.
9Ɛnyɛ wɔn a wɔanyini pii na wɔnim nyansa,
na ɛnyɛ mpanin na wɔhunu atemmuo mu.
10Enti na mese: Montie me;
me nso mɛkyerɛ deɛ menim.
11Hwɛ, matwɛn ama mo akasa awie,
mayɛ aso mama mo nhunumusɛm,
sɛ mobɛhwehwɛ anya nsɛm.
12Na mewɛn m’aso sɛ meretie mo,
na hwɛ, obiara nni mo mu a n’asɛm tɔɔ Hiob aso mu,
na ɔtumi buaa ne nsɛm no.
13Na monnka sɛ: Yɛahunu nyansa;
Onyankopɔn na ɔnha no, na ɛnyɛ onipa.
14Ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ me na ɔkaa ne nsɛm no kyerɛɛ me,
na me nso, meremfa mo nsɛm no memmua no.
15Wɔn abam abu, wɔremmua bio,
na wɔn anomu nsɛm nso asa.
16Na sɛ wɔnkasa bio, na wɔgyina hɔ,
na wɔmmua bio nti, mentwɛn anaa?
17Me nso mɛbua me fam deɛ,
me nso, mɛkyerɛ deɛ menim.
18Na nsɛm ahyɛ me ma,
na honhom a ɛwɔ me mu no hyɛ me.
19Hwɛ, me yam te sɛ nsa a wɔntuu ano,
sɛ nsa kotokuo foforɔ a ɛrepɛ apaeɛ.
20Mɛkasa, na manya ahomeyɛ;
mɛbue m’ano, na mabua.
21Ɛmpare me sɛ mɛhwɛ obi anim,
na madɛfɛdɛfɛ m’ano mama onipa,
22na mennim m’ano adɛfɛdɛfɛ,
anka ebia ɛbɛka ketewaa sɛɛ, na me yɛfoɔ afa me akɔ.

Ɛnna mmarima baasa yi gyaee Hiob bua, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ n’ani so teneneeni. Na Busini Elihu a ɔyɛ Barakel ba a ɔfiri Ram abusua mu bo fui. Hiob na ne bo fuu no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔbu ne ho teneneeni sene Onyankopɔn. Na ne bo fuu ne mfɛfoɔ baasa no nso, sɛ wɔnnya mmuaeɛ bi bio, nanso wɔbuu Hiob fɔ. Na Elihu twɛn maa Hiob kasae ansa, ɛfiri sɛ wɔsene no panin. Na Elihu hunuu sɛ mmuaeɛ biara nni mmarima baasa no anomu bio no, ne bo fui.
Na Busini Elihu a ɔyɛ Barakel ba buaa sɛ:
Me deɛ, meyɛ abɔfra,
na mo deɛ moyɛ nkɔkoraa,
enti na metɔɔ me bo aseɛ,

aane, na mfeɛ dodoɔ nkyerɛ nyansa.
Ampa, honhom a ɛwɔ ɔdasani mu
ne Otumfoɔ ahome na ɛma no nhunumu.
Ɛnyɛ wɔn a wɔanyini pii na wɔnim nyansa,

Enti na mese: Montie me;

Ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ me na ɔkaa ne nsɛm no kyerɛɛ me,

Wɔn abam abu, wɔremmua bio,

Na sɛ wɔnkasa bio, na wɔgyina hɔ,

Me nso mɛbua me fam deɛ,
me nso, mɛkyerɛ deɛ menim.
Na nsɛm ahyɛ me ma,
na honhom a ɛwɔ me mu no hyɛ me.
Hwɛ, me yam te sɛ nsa a wɔntuu ano,
sɛ nsa kotokuo foforɔ a ɛrepɛ apaeɛ.
Mɛkasa, na manya ahomeyɛ;
mɛbue m’ano, na mabua.
Ɛmpare me sɛ mɛhwɛ obi anim,
na madɛfɛdɛfɛ m’ano mama onipa,
na mennim m’ano adɛfɛdɛfɛ,

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
